description: Set up the feature-based project architecture (core, shared, features, layout), built the Home page sections — Hero, Categories, New Arrivals — plus the first reusable components — Header, SearchBar, ProductCard, Button — and got parent-child communication working with input() and output().

Added routing with lazy loading, built the Shop, Product Details, Cart, Auth, and Not Found pages, wired up CI/CD with GitHub Actions, and started using Angular Signals — signal(), computed(), and effect() — to manage state reactively across the app.

Replaced template inputs with Reactive Forms across Login, Register, and Profile, wrote a custom password validator, added product sorting and search with a custom pipe and a NothingFound empty state, built the PromoCode component, and learned ControlValueAccessor the hard way — by forgetting it once.

Connected the whole app to the real commercetools API — authentication, profile and address management, product catalog with search and filtering, and a fully working cart with add/update/remove through Cart Update Actions — plus an HTTP interceptor, RxJS operators, and our first real unit tests.
